resultAnatomyFromCode.get_trending: A text content block (the edition line, then up to five headlines per section, each with source name and URL) plus structuredContent shaped by the tool's declared outputSchema: the edition, the sections with their headlines as title, source, and URL data, and the headline count. Both renderings are built from one grouping in functions/api/mcp.js, so they cannot disagree.
resultAnatomyFromCode.search_literature: A text content block plus structuredContent. The text: the answer text; then, when the answer was assembled from source excerpts or the pipeline degraded, one plain quality note saying so; then a Sources section of numbered lines (title, authors, year, DOI or URL, and whether the source was cited in the answer or is further reading); then a Coverage line (records gathered and sources cited) when the payload carries a funnel; then a coverage note when present; then, when the search stored a Search record, a block naming the record's permanent address, its question, its time, and its source and database counts. With no sources, the text says plainly that the answer should be treated as ungrounded. The structuredContent carries the same facts as data, shaped by the tool's declared outputSchema: the answer text, the synthesis mode, the degraded flag, the sources as objects (title, authors, year, DOI, URL, cited), the source and cited counts, the coverage counts and note, and the record object with its permanent address when a record was stored. Nulls are honest: a field the payload does not carry ships as null.

structuredContentStatus: In the endpoint code as of 2026-10-14 (functions/api/mcp.js, with the per tool outputSchema declarations). The live build probed on 2026-10-14 (848a221) predates that code: its tools/call results carried only content and isError, verified by inspecting the result keys of a live search call. The same code change adds the icon and documentation address to the initialize result and to the GET description; the live initialize and GET responses probed on 2026-10-14 do not yet carry them. Before submitting to either directory, rerun these probes against the live endpoint and confirm structuredContent, the icon, and the documentation address are present live, because both directories scan the live server, not this package.

toolCallObservations.observed: Worked. Returned the 2026-10-14 edition: sections including Biology & Medicine and Preprints, five headlines each, each headline carrying its source name and the original story URL. Result isError false. The result carried no structuredContent; see structuredContentStatus.

One call on 14 October 2026 (how do wood frogs survive freezing). Returned a full synthesized AI answer with numbered citations in 13.6 seconds, isError false. The result keys were exactly content and isError: no structuredContent, because the live build probed predates the structured output code. See structuredContentStatus. Earlier calls on 13 October 2026 (bees and stinging, frogs surviving freezing, sleep and colds, plants folding their leaves) also all returned isError false: one full synthesized answer and three extractive answers in the What the sources say shape, whose result text discloses that assembly honestly. See the reliability note in README.md.
